text:
Noah Li: hey all, day 3 here. who should i ping when a rollout is stuck because of infra quotas or a missing owner? onboarding doc mentions "owners" but not the live escalation flow.
Maya Brooks: welcome Noah! short flow: if it's infra quota or bucket/SA, ping #eng-infra or Platform oncall. if it's app config / route ownership, check the service's OWNERS and ping the primary. if no reply in 30m, escalate to eng-oncall.
Noah Li: where do i find the OWNERS file for services? repo root?
Maya Brooks: each service repo has `infra/OWNERS.md`. it lists primary, secondary, and a backup oncall email. most services also have a CODEOWNERS entry in the repo.
Tomas Vega: adding: for production-impacting rollouts use pager duty. Steps: 1) open a ticket with the service name + impact, 2) ping #eng-oncall with the ticket link, 3) Platform oncall will triage infra actions. If it's a security or PII issue, page sec-oncall immediately.
Noah Li: good to know. any guidance on who actually approves emergency quota increases? sometimes we need a quick bump to finish a deploy.
Tomas Vega: infra manager or platform lead must approve quota increases > 24h. Oncall can approve timeboxed increases (<=4h) to unblock a deploy. Make sure to record reason + rollback plan in the ticket.
Noah Li: thanks. one more: onboarding says to file requests via infra@redwood-infer.com vs #new-hires. which is faster?
Maya Brooks: #new-hires is fine for quick triage but always create a ticket for auditability. The ticket is the source of truth. If urgent, paste ticket into the channel when you ping oncall.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: include manager approval for credential or long-lived access requests. Contractors need people-ops approval too.
Noah Li: spelled out. also anyone know who owns the billing alerts config? i got paged once and didn't know who to contact.
Tomas Vega: billing alerts owned by FinOps. contact finops@redwood-infer.com. For immediate paging issues, ping #finance and tag the finance oncall (listed in the FinOps README).
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-4099 created by Tomas Vega: "short-lived quota bump for noah.li@redwood-infer.com" 1h ETA
Noah Li: great, thanks everyone! saving this thread for others who are onboarding. :raised_hands:
Maya Brooks: welcome again :tada:
